name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; python3 -m pip install --user -r requirements.txt; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'

postAttachCommand.server: python3 -m streamlit run dr_display.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
